title: Not now. Meetings. 😂
description:
Not now. Meetings.. Bubbles sits upright in his crib at 3 PM, arms crossed, glaring into the camera while an adult hand reaches in to pull the curtain closed.

"Absolutely not. I have meetings." — Bubbles

Bubbles the Baby CEO: A baby. A boardroom. Zero patience for meetings.
Follow for a new episode every day.
